title: False LinkLayer.send result can later transmit and duplicate caller retries
description: Security/robustness review: busy CAD and radio-false resolve send reservations False while deliberately leaving the exact frame queued. A caller can reasonably retry after False; later drain transmits both original and retry with distinct counters, so replay protection accepts duplicate application effects. Make False terminal by atomically removing/canceling that entry, or expose a distinct bounded DEFERRED outcome while keeping completion unresolved. Test caller retry plus later drain for at-most-once semantics.
